title: Swap.org
tagline: Add starknet support to swap.org AMM swap and bridge on popular chains and EVM
description:
Swap.org currently supports BNB, I would like to add starknet support. Swap.org objective is to be a simple one-stop shop where you can swap and bridge across all chains and evms
It's not really a technical project, mostly connecting existing apps into one interface for beginners.
how_its_made:
It's just the front-end, the back-end will use existing smart-contract from AMM / Swap popular website like jediswap.
I need to support argent X and Braavos wallet.
In the future the plans is to offer free swap with a sponsor paying for swap fees, this is useful where you start in crypto and just have USDC or some crypto, but not the native coin.
